summary: Capital One Funding, LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $1.6 billion issuance of Class A(2026-2) asset-backed notes by the Capital One Multi-asset Execution Trust. The notes carry a 5.11% interest rate, priced at 99.93489% of par with a $6.4 million underwriting discount, for proceeds of ~$1.5926 billion. The transaction is a routine securitization of credit card receivables originated by Capital One, N.A., with no special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There is no board recommendation or strategic review; the filing is a standard capital markets offering.
